name: StayOnBeat
description:
StayOnBeat is a digital harm reduction and personal safety app designed for festival and club environments.

Features:
• Vibe Check — track how you feel throughout the night
• Pulse Lab — log your session and stay aware of your consumption
• Love Circle — stay connected with your group
• AI Safety Advisor — get personalized safety guidance
• Works offline — no internet required at festivals

StayOnBeat is built on harm reduction principles. It does not encourage or facilitate illegal activity. All tools are designed to promote personal awareness, safety, and informed decision-making.
For ages 18 and above.
